title: Data Entry
subtitle: Enter activity data and preview emissions from the TonyAI calculation engine
noSubsidiaries: No subsidiaries accessible to your account.
notSpecifiedLegacy: Not specified (entered before fuels were tracked)
factorGeographySource: {geography}, from {source}. Change it on the Subsidiaries page.

factorCoverage.none: No emission factors are loaded, so no record can be calculated yet.
factorCoverage.uncovered: No emission factor is defined for {geography} in {year}, so a record here cannot be calculated.
factorCoverage.placeholderSelected: {geography} in {year} rests on placeholder factors, which are not authoritative.

unitHelp: This value and unit drive the emissions calculation. The engine normalises the unit (e.g. MWh → kWh) before applying the factor.
pickRequired: Pick a subsidiary, category, and enter an activity value.
draftSavedAnomalous: Draft saved — value flagged as anomalous, add a variance comment
movedDraftSavedAnomalous: Moved to {entity}, draft saved — value flagged as anomalous, add a variance comment
anomalousBeforeSubmit: This value looks anomalous — add a variance comment before submitting.
aboveCeilingBeforeSubmit: This first-period figure is above the plausibility ceiling for its category — check the evidence and the unit, and add a variance comment before submitting.
evidenceBeforeSubmit: Saved. Attach at least one evidence file below, then submit again.
duplicateAdvice: Open it from Previous submissions to continue it.
duplicateAdviceMoving: The record has not been moved, and stays where it is.
saveFailedServer: Could not save — the server failed to process this record. Try again, and report it if it persists.
previewPrompt: Pick a subsidiary and category, then enter an activity value to see a live tCO₂e estimate.

bulkPreview.title: Accepted rows
bulkPreview.readNote: Numbers in a file are read with a point as the decimal separator: 1.234 means 1.234, not 1,234. Check each amount before you import.

conversionNote.detail: {fromUnit} → {toUnit}: ×{multiplier}. Calorific basis: {calorificBasis}. Derivation: {basis}. Reference conditions: {conditions}. Release: {publisher}, {edition} — {status}.
conversionNote.ncvDetail: {fromUnit} → {toUnit}: ×{multiplier}, at this record's net calorific value of {ncv} kcal/Sm³ ({origin}).{volume} Reference conditions: {conditions}. Release: {publisher}, {edition} — {status}.

ncvOrigin.derived: derived from the billed gross calorific value

inputs.title: Calculation inputs
inputs.ncvDefault: Default {value} kcal/Sm³, from {publisher} {edition}{status}. Change it only if your supplier states another value.
inputs.ncvDerived: Derived from the billed gross calorific value, so it is not entered here.
inputs.gcvHelp: Optional: the value printed on the bill. Enter it or change the net value, not both.
inputs.gcvBlocked: Put the net calorific value back to its default to enter a billed value instead.
inputs.volumeCorrectionHelp: Required for a metered reading in m³: it brings the volume to standard cubic metres.

volumeCorrectionInfo.standard: It converts the volume read from the meter in m³ to standard cubic metres (Sm³): gas at 15 °C and 1013.25 mbar.
volumeCorrectionInfo.arithmetic: Metered value × factor = Sm³. The Sm³ is then converted to energy at the net calorific value above.
volumeCorrectionInfo.standardUnit: If your bill already states the quantity in Sm³, choose the Sm³ unit instead and enter no factor.

inputs.referenceLoading: Loading the factor release's reference values…
inputs.referenceMissing: No factor release covers this record yet, so no default is shown.
inputs.referenceFailed: The factor release's reference values could not be loaded.

gasIssues.volume_correction_required: Enter the volume correction factor for a reading in m³.
gasIssues.ncv_and_gcv: Enter a net calorific value or a billed gross calorific value, not both.

inputs.equipmentHelp: One line per equipment type, for the whole year. The leak is priced at each type's rate on its installed capacity, plus what was refilled.
inputs.rateUnknown: No rate in the factor release yet
inputs.totalHelp: The sum of the capacities below: this is the record's quantity.
inputs.annualOnly: Refrigerant records in Türkiye are annual, because the leak rates are yearly.

equipmentIssues.no_lines: Add at least one equipment line.
equipmentIssues.type_missing: Choose the equipment type of every line.
equipmentIssues.type_repeated: Each equipment type takes one line.
equipmentIssues.value_missing: Enter a valid capacity and refill on every line (0 for none).
equipmentIssues.empty_line: Each line needs a capacity, a refill, or both.
equipmentIssues.too_large: The total capacity is too large.

inputs.unitReset: This facility follows the Türkiye rules, so the unit is now {unit} and the value was cleared. Enter it again.
inputs.marineGasOilScope: Marine gas oil covers vessels your company owns or operates (Scope 1), including a bareboat charter it operates. Leave out vessels you charter but do not operate (voyage or time charter) and third-party shipping: they are Scope 3, outside this inventory. Enter the mass on the Bunker Delivery Note, in kg or tonnes.

invalidLinkYear: This link's reporting year is not valid, so the link was not applied.
selectAllLoadedName: Select all {count} loaded: every draft you entered and can send, among the records loaded
previousShown: Showing {shown} of {total}. Selections apply to the records loaded here.
previousShownLoaded: Showing {shown} loaded. Selections apply to the records loaded here.
subsidiaryUnavailable: That subsidiary is not available to you.
recordsExist: {total} {category} records exist for {year}. Pick one from Previous submissions, or enter another period.
severalRecordsExist: Several {category} records exist for {year}. Pick one from Previous submissions, or enter another period.
notEditable: This record is {status} and can no longer be edited.
notYourRecord: This record was entered by someone else — only its author can change it.
periodLockedRecord: {period} {year} is locked — a super_admin must unlock it before this record can change.
nowEnteringNew: Now entering a new record — the one you opened is untouched.

context.title: Additional context
context.refused: A number in Additional context is not valid — correct it or clear it before saving.

anomaly.verifyAndExplain: Please verify it and explain the variance before submitting.
anomaly.variancePlaceholder: e.g. new production line commissioned this period

preview.unitConverted: Unit converted from {from} to {to} before applying the factor.
preview.invoiceRequired: You can still save and submit this entry. An invoice is required before it can be submitted, since without an emission factor the invoice is the only record of what was consumed.
preview.invoiceCompleteness: Recorded against a facility for a single month, it also counts towards that facility's invoice completeness — which is measured from the invoice, not from the calculated figure.

submissions.title: Previous submissions
submissions.attachStart: Attach one file to several records
submissions.attachHint: Tick the records this one document evidences.
submissions.preselectLoading: Reading the year's other gas records to tick them…
submissions.preselectMissingOne: 1 gas record of the year could not be ticked automatically. Tick it by hand, or attach without it.
submissions.preselectMissingMany: {count} gas records of the year could not be ticked automatically. Tick them by hand, or attach without them.
submissions.empty: No submissions yet for this subsidiary.

move.withFigure: Saving moves this record from {from} to {to}. It is not copied — the emission factor is recalculated for its geography.
move.withoutFigure: Saving moves this record from {from} to {to}. It is not copied — and no emission factor resolves for it today, so it stays "Not calculated".

editMode.title: Editing record {id}
editMode.hint: Saving changes this record itself — no new record is created.
editMode.savedAnomalous: Changes saved to the record. The value deviates from its history — add a variance comment before submitting.
editMode.savedAboveCeiling: Changes saved to the record. This first-period figure is above the plausibility ceiling for its category — check the evidence and the unit, and add a variance comment before submitting.

evidence.removeAllTitle: Changing the category removes this record's {count} evidence file(s):
evidence.deletionWarning: A file that backs no other record is deleted and must be uploaded again.
evidence.chooseTitle: Keep or remove each file for the changed record:

recall.title: Recall this submission?
recall.body: {record} leaves the review queue and becomes your draft again. You can edit it and submit it again.
recall.done: Recalled to draft. Edit it, then submit it again.

copy.loaded: A new draft is filled in from the voided record. Check the values, save it and attach its evidence.
copy.notVoided: Only a voided record can be copied to a new draft.

heldEvidence.uploadFailed: The record is saved as a draft, but these files did not upload: {files}. Retry them under Evidence.
heldEvidence.notUploaded: The draft is saved, but you moved on before these files were uploaded: {files}. Open the draft to attach them.
heldEvidence.resolveFailed: Retry or remove the files that did not upload before you submit.

bulkSection.title: Bulk upload
bulkSection.hint: Import many records from a file, and see recent imports
